### AS40220 


![](/routing-bgp/MARIA-Network-BW-768x441.jpg){fig-alt="Diagram of the Mid-Atlantic Research Infrastructure Alliance network, showing major connectivity locations in Ashburn and Atlanta, and networks connecting major Universities in Virginia (including Virginia Tech, University of Virginia, VCU, William and Mary, James Madison). Most schools and the Ashburn site are connected via 100Gbps channels, but some only via 1-10Gbps leased service. In the Hampton Roads and Blacksburg areas, MARIA runs a 'Member Metro Network'. For the Altanta site, the MARIA is only connected via 1-10Gbps leased service (albeit redundantly from Charlottesville, Hampton Roads and Blacksburg)."}
